page.notes: The page carries a woodcut figure, not running text. Its printed labels are: ORIENS (top), OCCIDENS (bottom), MERIDIES (right), SEPTENTRIO (left, in the border); PARALLELI SEPTENTRIONALES (left inside the oval); PARALLELI AUSTRALES (right inside the oval); AEQVA[TOR] (across the centre, partly illegible); and numbered graduation marks along the two curved lines, 1 to 24 on the upper left and 1 to 24 on the lower right, partly illegible at this scan. The catchword is set at the lower right. A faint signature mark at the lower left is not legible and is omitted.
